purpose: Prospectively test whether a parameter-free, within-case rank-concurrence gate can abstain on missing contract evidence without the cross-document threshold instability and evidence loss observed in v51.
source_access_order: Freeze this protocol, implementation, runner and synthetic tests and register their SHA-256 values before opening train content.
Open only train.json, form the frozen balanced sample and write a label-free blind cache plus opaque source commitments.
Register the blind artifact hashes, exact CUDA runtime and source manifest before query generation or neural scoring.
Generate deterministic queries and score every retained candidate span for all 600 cases before any gold evidence is joined.
After the complete score cache hash is locked, reopen only train.json once to validate candidate coverage, join gold and evaluate all registered methods.
Publish positive, negative, null or inconclusive outcomes and permanently forbid confirmation reuse.

source_schema_rule_inherited_from_v50.rule: Skip only official spans whose exact half-open text slice is whitespace-only, preserve every retained span's original span_NNNN index, and fail before queries if any gold evidence id is absent.

confirmation_scope.sampling: Within each label, frozen SHA-256 order over label, document id and hypothesis key; advance labels in lockstep under the shared six-per-document cap; fail before scoring unless exactly 200 per label can be formed.

blind_candidate_and_query_contract.candidate_pool: Every retained non-whitespace official span in the full given contract, with original canonical span_NNNN id.

query_templates.first_fact: Find contract language that directly entails or supports the following statement: {hypothesis}
query_templates.second_fact_or_bridge: Find contract language that contradicts, negates, or rules out the following statement: {hypothesis}
query_templates.counterevidence: Find exceptions, exclusions, limitations, or scope conditions relevant to the following statement: {hypothesis}

rank_concurrence_gate.per_role_winner: Sort candidates by descending raw reranker logit for that role, then ascending canonical candidate id; take exactly the first candidate.
rank_concurrence_gate.pass_rule: Pass if and only if the anchor winner id equals the first_fact winner id or equals the second_fact_or_bridge winner id.
rank_concurrence_gate.fail_rule: Return the empty evidence set when the pass rule is false.
invariances: strictly increasing transformation applied independently to each role's logits
additive shift applied independently to each role
positive scale applied independently to each role

confirmation_methods.span_nli_bert: Paper reference only; no compatible released trained weight is claimed, simulated or included as an executable baseline.
confirmation_methods.setr: Not claimed or simulated; unavailable trained SetR weights are not an executable baseline.

confirmation_evaluation.per_case_metric: Evidence-set F1 for Entailment or Contradiction; exact empty-selection accuracy for NotMentioned.

known_scope_limits: This is full-given-contract span selection and missing-evidence abstention, not open-corpus retrieval or end-to-end NLI classification.
The official train split is intentionally role-reversed as untouched confirmation and this is not an official ContractNLI leaderboard result.
The hypothesis was designed after aggregate v50 and v51 failures were known, although no v50 or v51 case-level artifact is used.
A positive result would support only this frozen rank gate under this protocol; it would not reproduce Span NLI BERT, SetR or a flood-domain expert evaluation.
